final: WITH valid_signals AS (SELECT rfistat, modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM valid_signals), qualifying AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM valid_signals GROUP BY rfistat HAVING AVG(modindex) > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall)) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS above_overall_avg, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying
